title: The neutral Gauss constraint is a global split coordinate

split_coordinate.phase_scope: The completed triangular phase space of the repository scalar-electrodynamics control on the trivial bundle over T3, restricted to the neutral sector where rho=e Im<Qphi,pi> has zero spatial mean
split_coordinate.right_inverse: R g=-grad(-Delta)^(-1)g is bounded H^-1_0 to L2 and satisfies div Rg=g
split_coordinate.transverse_projection: P_T E=E-R(div E), so div P_T E=0
split_coordinate.coordinate_map: (E,phi,pi) maps to (g=G(E,phi,pi), E_T=P_T E, phi, pi)
split_coordinate.global_identity: The two maps are mutual inverses on the declared completed topology; the Gauss surface is exactly the hyperplane g=0 in split coordinates
split_coordinate.submersion: D_E G=div is split-surjective at every point with the same bounded right inverse R, so no field-dependent rank jump occurs in the based neutral Gauss constraint
split_coordinate.boundary: This is a global functional coordinate for the repository Gauss constraint, not a source GU constraint, an evolution theorem or a quantization
